title: Management fees: who pays and until when

source.title: Harel child-savings standard bylaw, April 2026, ss.31-33 (0.23% of balance, 0% of deposits); Altshuler Q&A states the same after 21

fee_after_21.notes: Yearly fee on the balance once the child is 21 (until 21 the National Insurance Institute pays the cost, at 0.23% a year to provident funds per the NII 2025 report, p.1, primary). Institution strength for the after-21 rate: Harel's bylaw and an Altshuler Q&A; whether 0.23% holds at all nine or ten managers was not checked (open question 8). A manager may raise it after 21 by notice (Harel s.33). The rule-level strength 'primary' is the law s.74ב(ה) (NII bears the cost); this figure is institution.
